name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: An open teaching project that shows you how to train a tiny (64M parameter) AI language model from scratch for about the cost of a cup of coffee.
buyer: Not a commercial buyer — this is an education/research project for people learning how large language models work internally.
business_use_cases: A university AI course adopts it as lab material so students train a real (if small) LLM instead of only calling APIs.
A corporate AI-literacy trainer uses it as a hands-on demo to de-mystify LLMs for non-technical executives.
A content creator builds a paid video series walking through the code, monetizing the explanation rather than the code itself.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a structured paid course or workshop series built around reproducing the project step by step.

steal_this: There's no product here to sell, just teaching material — the realistic move is recording a 'build your own LLM in a weekend' paid workshop using this as the curriculum.
